description: This is a unit test class for the LocationDao class in the OrangeHRM project. It contains test methods to verify the behavior of LocationDao methods such as fetching locations by ID, searching locations based on filters, and retrieving location IDs for employees.

classes.name: LocationDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the LocationDao data access object methods within the OrangeHRM HR management system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test fixture, creating an instance of LocationDao and populating test data from a YAML fixture file.

methods.name: testGetLocationById
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a Location object by its ID (expected to exist).

methods.name: testGetLocationByIdForNonExistingId
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a Location object for a non-existing ID, expecting null.

methods.name: testGetNumberOfEmployeesForLocation
methods.description: Verifies the count of employees associated with a specific location.

methods.name: testGetLocationList
methods.description: Checks the retrieval of the list of location IDs.

methods.name: testSearchLocationsForNullArray
methods.description: Tests search functionality with default filter parameters (none set).

methods.name: testSearchLocationsForLocationName
methods.description: Tests location search filtered by name.

methods.name: testSearchLocationsForCity
methods.description: Tests location search filtered by city.

methods.name: testSearchLocationsForCountry
methods.description: Tests location search filtered by country code.

methods.name: testGetSearchLocationListCount
methods.description: Verifies count of locations matching specific search filters.

methods.name: testGetLocationIdsForEmployees
methods.description: Checks location IDs associated with a list of employee numbers.

methods.name: testGetLocationIdsForEmployeesOneEmployee
methods.description: Checks location IDs for a single employee.

methods.name: testGetLocationIdsForEmployeesNoEmployees
methods.description: Ensures empty result when no employees provided.

methods.name: testGetLocationIdsForEmployeesEmployeesWithoutLocations
methods.description: Checks behavior when employees have no assigned locations.

methods.name: testGetLocationIdsForEmployeesInvalidEmployees
methods.description: Checks behavior with non-existent employee IDs.

methods.name: testGetLocationsByIds
methods.description: Verifies fetching multiple Location objects by their IDs.
